{{Quote|Cargo transport 241, you are all clear.|A man on Horizon Base's PA system|<ref name="TFD" />}}
'''Imperial Cargo Transport 241''' was a [[Class four container transport|cargo ship]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] helmed by a [[Unidentified Imperial cargo ship captain|mustachioed captain]].<ref name="TFD" /> At some point during [[3 BBY]],<ref name="Dawn">''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]''</ref> the transport docked at the [[Horizon Base]]. Upon leaving the dock, however, an [[astromech droid]] known as [[C1-10P|Chopper]], affiliated with anti-Empire rebels, had embarked as a stowaway on the transport. After incapacitating the captain and jettisoning the Imperial [[stormtrooper]]s along with the freight assembly, Chopper took control of the transport, with the help of the craft's own [[inventory droid]], [[AP-5]].<ref name="TFD" />

The transport was then salvaged and looted to become the foundations of [[Chopper Base]] on [[Atollon]].<ref name="Dawn" />
